text:
Maya Patel: Hey everyone — reminder: all-hands this Wednesday 10:00am PT (Zoom link in calendar). Quick agenda below, recording link will be posted after the meeting. Please drop any Qs in this thread or add them to the short form: https://forms.gle/ah-qna-2026

Maya Patel: Agenda (20–30 min total):
```
- 10:00 — 10:05 Intro + company metrics (Maya)
- 10:05 — 10:12 Dedicated launch status & rollout plan (Samir)
- 10:12 — 10:17 Incident recap: brief postmortem of Friday outage (Carl)
- 10:17 — 10:25 Product roadmap highlights + AMA (Anna)
- 10:25 — 10:30 Ops/people announcements + next steps
```

Maya Patel: If you have something that needs deep discussion, tag the thread and we'll queue it for follow-up with the relevant team.

Carl Rivera: Quick timezone note — we have a couple of early-morning folks in APAC, can we add the recording link to the calendar invite for people who can't make it? :slightly_smiling_face:

Maya Patel: @Carl — yes, recording will be uploaded to the calendar and posted here right after. We'll also pin the recording in #all-hands.

Jess O'Neill: Drop Q: can we get more detail on pricing tiers for Dedicated? will there be overage policies? I've added it to the form.

Samir Gupta: I'll cover the Dedicated rollout and the overage/backfill options. TL;DR: committed capacity + burst pools, policy details coming in the doc.

Anna Chen: I'll do a short AMA on roadmap direction and what we're prioritizing for the next two quarters. If you want product-level detail, drop questions here.

OpsBot: Reminder: All-hands scheduled in 48 hours. If you need to add agenda items, reply in this thread or ping @Maya.

Jess O'Neill: Also — heads up for people who want in-person watch: we'll have a small SF watch party (limited spots, RSVP in the calendar). Pizza provided :pizza:

Samir Gupta: Postmortem note: Friday's outage was tied to an autoscaler regression during a rollout. Carl will summarize the postmortem and next steps (short), full postmortem doc to follow.

Carl Rivera: Yep — will present the five-minute summary and link to the full postmortem doc in #incidents after the call.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — last ask: if you can't make it but have questions, add them to the form or drop them here and we'll surface them in the AMA. Recording + slides posted after. :wave:

Anna Chen: Thanks team — excited to share progress and hear feedback.

Samir Gupta: Added a slide with rollout timeline; will pin the doc during the call.

Jess O'Neill: Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Carl Rivera: See you all.

[MESSAGE ENDS]
